title: CmdPal: Add bookmark import and export commands

proposed_comments.title: Avoid exporting files the importer rejects
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid exporting files the importer rejects

**Severity:** `medium`

Export writes the entire bookmark collection without applying the importer’s 10,000-entry and 10 MiB limits. A collection can exceed those limits after multiple valid imports or individual additions, so export reports success but the saved file cannot be imported on another machine.

Please make the two operations consistent. For example, serialize once and check both the entry count and UTF-8 byte length before `WriteAtomically`, returning a localized failure without replacing the destination when the file cannot be imported; alternatively, support importing the full output. Cover both JSON and TSV at the limits and just above them.

confidence.rationale: The exact-head focused test verifies Serialize of 10001 entries is rejected by Parse in both JSON and TSV; the export path imposes no limits.
